title: I shipped a green PR. /ultrareview caught what CI missed
description:
I shipped a green PR last Tuesday. CI passed, my team approved it, and prod broke Friday. /ultrareview would have caught it.

This deep-dive walks through Anthropic's /ultrareview — the cloud-based multi-agent code review fleet that shipped to public preview on April 20, 2026. We run it on a real local branch, walk one finding end-to-end, and unpack the cost tradeoff most reactions skip past.

What's in the video:
- The single command that spins up a multi-agent review fleet in the cloud
- Local form (no GitHub remote required) vs. /ultrareview <PR#> for remote PRs
- A live demo: five agents, one race condition CI never flagged
- Why /ultrareview is billed per run — and why that should change how you use it
- Where it replaces (and doesn't replace) a human reviewer
